note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the rule text is the author's illustrative text, not a statement of any law. Both scenes share every fact except the supplied spot; no winner, score or outcome is shown.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional delivery: scene A leaves the parcel on the porch bench, scene B (hypothetical) on the window sill; the figurines walk in lockstep and B stops earlier. Shared facts and the fictional house notice are drawn once; the changed fact is related to condition 2.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a fictional equipment return in which B's flag hops from the wall parcel box down to the bench below — the figurine in B reaches low while A's reaches up into the box (different geometry at the same stop). Different shared facts, a two-condition rule, two issues.

conditions: at the place named in the note

issues: Which place does the note name?
Is the bench part of the front?
assumptions: The tenant's route is the same in both scenes

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long scenario labels and captions, long events, shared facts, rule text, changed fact, guide label, neutral note, issues and assumptions.

facts.title: Evening delivery of a parcel at number 9 of fictional Linden Street
events: A courier from a fictional delivery service arrives at the garden at 18:10
The courier carries parcel number 7 all the way up to the house front
The courier leaves the parcel there and steps back towards the garden

rules.title: House notice number 2 of the residents' association (illustrative)
conditions: A parcel addressed to a resident of the house is left for that resident
at a place that was agreed in advance with the resident concerned
before seven o'clock in the evening of the delivery day

issues: Was the stone window sill ever agreed with the resident as a place for parcels?
assumptions: Every other event happens exactly as in the base scene
The courier's route and timing are the same in both scenes

scenarioA.label: Scenario A — the base scene as supplied
scenarioA.caption: The parcel is left on the wooden bench under the porch roof

scenarioB.label: Scenario B — what if the spot were different
scenarioB.caption: The parcel is left on the stone sill of the front window instead

params.changedFact: The only change between the two scenes: the exact place where the courier finally leaves the parcel
sharedFacts: Same courier, same route and the same timing in both scenes
Same house front, same garden and the same notice text

comparisonLabels.neutral: Two variants of one fictional example shown side by side — no outcome, winner or score is shown
